dbi_complaints.nov_item_description: recharge and date tag all fire extinguishers. fire extinguishers are required in common area on all occupied levels.

dbi_complaints.item: provide a minimum one carbon monixide alarm/detector per dwelling unit/apartment(907.2.11 (sfbc)
dbi_complaints.nov_item_description: provide a affidavit-self certification for the smoke detector & carbon monoxide alarms test smoke detectors on a regular basis and replace batteries annually to maintain a working and functional device. advise occupants not to disconnect the batteries or remove the units inside the apartments or from public areas.

dbi_complaints.item: maintain fire escape drop ladder in working condition (sec 908 hc)
dbi_complaints.nov_item_description: on the east side of the building. note: on reinspection day, property manager, owner or the owner's agent needs to demonstrate the workability of the fire escape ladders. provide a written and signed report from a qualified service company or contractor stating that all parts and cables have been tested and are functional or you are required to lower the ladder on re-inspection day to verify its proper full release. all fire escape drop ladders must be maintained and serviced annually, particularly the cable and all moving parts. lubricate and drop the ladder at least once a year.
